english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for different kinds or a range of things.
Use this as the all-purpose choice when talking about a kind or type of thing in ordinary speech.
Use this when “description” means a type or category rather than a verbal account.
Use this when “nature” means a sort, type, or general class of thing.

examples.english: This shop has a wide variety of tea.
examples.traditional: 呢間舖有好多種類嘅茶。
examples.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 pou3 jau5 hou2 do1 zung2 leoi6 ge3 caa4

examples.english: These products belong to the same category.
examples.traditional: 呢啲貨品屬於同一種類。
examples.jyutping: ni1 di1 fo3 ban2 suk6 jyu1 tung4 jat1 zung2 leoi6

examples.english: Tea can be divided into many types, and this description refers to one of them.
examples.traditional: 茶可以分好多種類，呢個描述就係其中一種。
examples.jyutping: caa4 ho2 ji5 fan1 hou2 do1 zung2 leoi6 ni1 go3 miu4 seot6 zau6 hai6 kei4 zung1 jat1 zung2

examples.english: By nature, these two kinds of tea taste very different.
examples.traditional: 就種類嚟講，呢兩種茶嘅味道好唔同。
examples.jyutping: zau6 zung2 leoi6 lai4 gong2 ni1 loeng5 zung2 caa4 ge3 mei6 dou6 hou2 m4 tung4
